newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re in venture with Crawford. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re in venture with Crawford. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co. said it had signed a preliminary agreement with Crawford & Co of Atlanta to found a joint venture in the area of loss adjustment and claims management, Crawford-THG Ltd.
Crawford will own 60 percent of the venture and Swiss Re the remaining 40 percent. The venture should have annual sales of some $200 million, Swiss Re said in a statement.
As part of the agreement, Swiss Re will sell the Thomas Howell Group (THG) THG Americas to Crawford for $9.0 million.
THG was acquired by Swiss Re in 1988 and had 1995 sales of about $114 million and showed a loss of around $6.0 million, mainly due to restructuring.
(Corrects to make clear that Swiss Re is only selling the U.S. subsidiary of Thomas Howell Group to Crawford)
A final contract is expected to be signed by mid-December, assuming approval by authorities, so Crawford-THG can start operating on January 1, 1997.
